sahneler.metin: In an earthquake, Oakland's double-deck freeway collapsed onto itself.
The top deck crushed cars below, and forty two people died.
It stood on soft mud near the bay.
The concrete columns had too little steel to bend.
Section after section of upper deck came down.
California then retrofitted its freeways to bend, not break.
